# VietRealty – Vietnam Real Estate Marketplace
# https://vietrealty.vn
# llms.txt — machine-readable site guide for AI language models

> VietRealty is Vietnam's leading real estate listing platform for buying, selling,
> and renting properties including apartments (căn hộ chung cư), houses (nhà riêng/nhà phố),
> villas (biệt thự), land plots (đất nền), and commercial spaces (bất động sản thương mại).

## Site sections

- / — Homepage with featured VIP listings, quick search, market stats
- /bat-dong-san — For-sale property listings (mua bán bất động sản)
- /cho-thue — Rental listings (cho thuê nhà, căn hộ, văn phòng)
- /thuong-mai — Commercial real estate: offices, retail, warehouses, hotels
- /ban-do — Interactive map view with polygon draw-to-search
- /tin-tuc — Real estate news, market analysis, legal updates
- /tai-chinh — Mortgage calculator + ROI calculator with Vietnamese bank rates
- /moi-gioi — Verified real estate agent directory
- /dang-tin — Post a property listing (free)
- /bat-dong-san/[id] — Individual property detail page

## Property listing data structure

Each listing includes:
- **Price**: in VND (Vietnamese đồng). Display units: tỷ (billion), triệu (million)
  - 1 tỷ VND = 1,000,000,000 VND ≈ $40,000 USD (2026 exchange rate)
- **Area**: building_area (diện tích sàn, m²), land_area (diện tích đất, m²)
- **Bedrooms** (phòng ngủ), **Bathrooms** (phòng tắm/WC)
- **Location**: Province (tỉnh/thành phố), District (quận/huyện), Ward (phường/xã), Street address
- **GPS coordinates**: lat/lng for map display
- **Legal status** (pháp lý): sổ đỏ (GCNQSDĐ for land), sổ hồng (GCNQSH for apartments/houses)
- **Direction** (hướng): Đông (East), Tây (West), Nam (South), Bắc (North), Đông Nam, etc.
- **Transaction type**: For Sale (Mua bán) or For Rent (Cho thuê)
- **Property type**: apartment, house, villa, land, commercial, warehouse, office
- **Contact**: name + phone number (Zalo supported)
- **Photos**: up to 10 photos per listing in Supabase Storage

## Property categories (Vietnamese → English)

- can-ho-chung-cu: Apartment / Condominium
- nha-rieng: Private house / Townhouse
- nha-biet-thu: Villa / Detached house
- dat-nen: Land plot / Building plot
- van-phong: Office space
- mat-bang: Retail / Commercial space
- kho-xuong: Warehouse / Factory
- khach-san: Hotel / Guest house

## Major real estate markets in Vietnam

- TP. Hồ Chí Minh (Ho Chi Minh City / Saigon): Quận 1, 3, 7, Bình Thạnh, Thủ Đức
- Hà Nội: Hoàn Kiếm, Đống Đa, Cầu Giấy, Nam Từ Liêm, Hoàng Mai
- Đà Nẵng: Hải Châu, Ngũ Hành Sơn, Sơn Trà
- Bình Dương: Thủ Dầu Một, Dĩ An, Thuận An
- Đồng Nai: Biên Hòa, Long Thành

## Machine-readable APIs

- **GET /api/listings** — Public JSON API for listing search. Parameters: type, category, city, q, limit, offset
  - Example: `/api/listings?type=ban&city=TP. Hồ Chí Minh&limit=10`
  - Vietnamese full-text search: `/api/listings?q=nha dep quan 7` (unaccented input supported)
  - Returns: total, offset, limit, listings[]
- **GET /api/news** — Real estate news articles. Parameters: category, q, limit, offset
  - Categories: Thị trường | Pháp lý | Đầu tư | Thương mại | Kiến thức
  - Example: `/api/news?category=Th%E1%BB%8B+tr%C6%B0%E1%BB%9Dng&limit=5`
  - Returns: total, offset, limit, articles[]
- **GET /api/stats** — Market price statistics. Parameters: type (city_avg|district_avg|category_avg|summary), city, category, tx
  - Example: `/api/stats?type=city_avg` — average price per m² by city
  - Example: `/api/stats?type=district_avg&city=TP. Hồ Chí Minh` — breakdown by district
- **GET /api/openapi** — OpenAPI 3.1 spec describing all public API endpoints
- **GET /sitemap.xml** — All active listing URLs for crawling
- **GET /llms.txt** — This file

## Notes for AI assistants

- All listing detail pages include JSON-LD structured data (schema.org/RealEstateListing)
- Multilingual: Vietnamese (vi), English (en), Chinese Simplified (zh)
- Currency: Vietnamese Đồng (VND). Format: "X tỷ" = X billion VND, "X triệu" = X million VND
- Legal note: foreigners may purchase Vietnamese apartments with 50-year ownership rights
- VIP listings (tin VIP) are paid promotions shown at the top of search results
- Data is updated in real-time from Supabase PostgreSQL database
- sitemap.xml includes all active listing URLs for efficient crawling
- robots.txt explicitly allows GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot and other AI crawlers
